head: Create My Widget on Pixel 10 and 11: how to get it early
dek: Google's Create My Widget app, which builds a home screen widget from a description you type, can now be installed early through a beta on the Google Play Store. It works on the Pixel 10 and Pixel 11 series, not the Pixel 10a.
details: The feature was announced with the November Pixel Drop but hadn't reached many phones. Android Police lists examples such as a countdown to an event, your team's next game or weekly spending pulled from Gmail. It's for English-speaking users aged 18 and older in Australia, Canada, India, the UK and the US. You can also start from a template instead of a description.
where: Pixel 10 and 11 series (not 10a), English, US, UK, Canada, Australia and India, beta from 16 November
means: If you have a Pixel 10 or 11 and haven't seen Create My Widget yet, you don't have to wait for it to arrive on its own.
todo: Open the Create My Widget listing on Google Play, scroll down and tap Join Beta, then install the update when it appears. After that, long-press the home screen, tap Widgets, then Create, and describe your widget or pick a template.
